evidence.decision: Separates wrist-glance value from prolonged interaction, chooses complication/notification/Action button by purpose and plans wrist-up/Always On continuity.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a glance/action flow, precise entrypoint destinations and wrist-state behavior or implementation.
evidence.transformation: Tea timer reduces four-screen phone recipe navigation to current steep time and Pause/Resume, with presets on Crown and a running-timer complication.
evidence.verification: Checks unrelated complication landing, routine deep navigation and lost wrist-down progress; Watch readability/Crown/sensor execution remains separately reported.
evidence.applicability: Requires independently useful Watch detail without copying all phone work; sensor access and Action button use depend on real value.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Crown, Always On or Action button only for the selected interaction rather than every Watch task.
evidence.distinctiveness: Wrist-state persistence and entrypoint-to-current-timer routing create an actionable Watch responsibility split.
